title: Stockholm and a benefit for Prince Carl
summary: In Stockholm he does a Red Cross benefit for Prince Carl of Sweden.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But you went -- so you went to Sweden and how long did you stay there? Was it at Stockholm?
Yeah, Stockholm. We played in the, I can't think of the name now. There we played in the -- I know
one thing, it was there that I did a benefit for the Prince Carl of Sweden, for the Red Cross.
And we had a great benefit. That was in the Haselbach, it was a great hall there. But the band played, I mean the show was in a place something like the Tivoli would be in Copenhagen.
